splitVotes.officialTitle: 261005SU - Douglas Ray Marcum, Special Use Permit (PL SUP-001054-2026), to Allow for a Private Outdoor Shooting Range, in a General Agriculture (A-1) Zone, 10.00 Acres, Parcel 14433-000-00, Site Address 3805 NE 77th Street, Ocala, FL 34479
splitVotes.motion: Motion by Commissioner Stone, second by Vice Chair Curry, to deny agenda item 15.4.4.  The motion failed 2 / 3.
splitVotes.headline: 261005SU - Douglas Ray Marcum, Special Use Permit (PL SUP-001054-2026), to Allow for a Private Outdoor Shooting Range, i
splitVotes.minutesNote:
Mr. Minter administered the oath to those who were not here at the beginning of the meeting. 

David Tillman-the Applicant spoke about the shooting range that already exists today. Today is to monetize the shooting range with conditions. Mr. Tillman reviewed the issues regarding noise impacts and environmental factors. The plan is to do the earth and berm process and recycle the fragments. Discussion was held on having a professional sound study being completed. The number of members was discussed, the plan is not to cap the memberships at a certain number, but there could possibly be 150 members. DIRECTION TO STAFF: The number of people allowed on site will be limited to the number of bays available. A site specific safety plan in writing shall be completed and an independent noise impact study was discussed. Regarding alcohol, if someone has been drinking they will not be allowed on the range. Mr. Tillman would install signs stating there is a shooting range ahead and horse riders could take the bypass trail. 

Bernard Little-represents Horse Farms Forever and is a user of Indian Lake State Park. He opposes the applicant's request.

Kathy Bryant-opposes the gun club due to the location and the adjoining property owners living so close by. 

Recess until 6:32 p.m.

Reconvened at 6:34 p.m.

David Tillman-the gun club and the horses/animals can coexist. He summarized the testimony today. There will not be another location for a member gun club that is already surrounded by clay/sand and is pretty much underground. 

Robin Hough-stated Code Enforcement does not respond to gunfire, the Sheriff's Office does. A 5-minute LEQ study must be done when Code Enforcement responds and then follow the table of decibels to see if is an offense. 

DIRECTION TO STAFF: Conditions: Hours will be from 8 a.m. to dusk or 8 p.m. For the night time shooting, the hours will end at 10:30 p.m. once a month with not two (2) consecutive nights with a minimum of seven (7) days separation (end and beginning of the next month). A sign posted on 326 alerting night shoot will be posted. The entire roadway will be a have a minimum stabilization requirement. The County Engineer always recommends asphalt roadway being constructed. Limerock will accommodate the easement for stabilization and will be designed to hold the weight accordingly. A background liner will be installed that follows DEP best management practices. There will be a shooting house over every area where there is shooting, with no other shooting other than shooting houses, a lift with a turn down side wall, with the SUP the Applicant must submit a best management practices/safety protocol with a time of the SUP being good for 3 years with 5 year renewals. Motion Bairstow/Curry at 7:17 pm with conditions. Opposed Stone/Curry motion passes at 7:18 pm motion passes 3-2.

Recess at 7:19 pm

Reconvened at 7:24 pm
